aiSummary.description_en: Normal results are summarized by scripts, and risk results are summarized by a large language model (LLM). This field includes the generation status and the original text upon success, and is empty if not generated
aiSummary.description_zh: 正常结果由脚本总结，风险结果由 LLM 总结；包含生成状态及成功后的原文，未生成时为空

status.description_en: The generation status of the summary. Valid values: Pending, Running, Succeeded, and Failed. This status does not affect the inspection result
status.description_zh: Pending 等待、Running 生成中、Succeeded 已生成、Failed 生成失败；不改变巡检结果

text.description_en: The result summary. This field is returned only when the generation succeeds. The summary contains a maximum of 200 characters and is not concatenated or truncated by the frontend
text.description_zh: 仅生成成功时返回，最多 200 字，不由前端拼接或截取
text.example: 本次巡检未发现风险，实例运行正常。

configSnapshot.description_en: The configuration snapshot for this inspection. This snapshot is not overwritten by subsequent modifications

items.description_en: The inspection item configurations. You can configure 1 to 20 items. The templateCode values must be unique. The entire array is replaced during updates. Time-based items use a unified window, with a default of 24 hours for single runs, and are overridden by intervalHours for periodic runs
items.description_zh: 巡检项配置；1～20 项，templateCode 不重复，整数组替换；时间类项目使用统一窗口，单次默认 24 小时，周期运行按 intervalHours 覆盖

parameters.description_en: The parameter JSON object for this item, not a JSON string. The parameters are validated against the parameter catalog, and omitted keys use default values. For time-based items, the lookback period must be unified, with a default of 24 hours for single runs, and intervalHours is used for periodic runs. Pass an empty object {} if no parameters are required. Nested timeWindow or thresholds are not allowed
parameters.description_zh: 本项参数 JSON 对象，非 JSON 字符串；按参数目录校验，省略键使用默认值；时间类项目 lookback 必须统一，单次默认 24h，周期运行使用 intervalHours；无参数传 {}；禁止 timeWindow/thresholds 嵌套

additionalProperties.description_en: The number of risky resources determined by scripts for this inspection item. The value is 0 if a full scan finds no hits.
